chunks.head: leave off
chunks.note: leave off (doing sth) = 停止、不再干某事;也指戒掉某习惯。此leave非'离开'义。

literal.note_cn: 此处与off合成'停止',非'离开'

chunks.ex_en: She left off talking when the teacher came in.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师进来时,她停下了话头。

chunks.head: go to sea
chunks.gloss: 出海航行;当水手、以航海为业
chunks.note: go to sea 不是'去海边',而是'出海航行'或'当水手谋生'。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'航海生涯',非泛指大海

chunks.ex_en: His dream was to go to sea and sail around the world.
chunks.ex_cn: 他的梦想是出海航行、环游世界。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to + 动词原形,表示目的。

literal.note_cn: 此处与in、to组成固定式,不作'命令'解

chunks.ex_en: She got up early in order to catch the first bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 她早起是为了赶上头班车。

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: 指'在这段时间里、在等待另一件事发生的同时'。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is not ready yet; in the meantime, have some tea.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭还没好;这段时间里先喝点茶吧。

chunks.head: every now and then
chunks.note: 表示'不经常但会反复出现'。

literal.note_cn: 与then搭配指'时而'
与now搭配指'又一阵'

chunks.ex_en: Every now and then she looks up from her book.
chunks.ex_cn: 她时不时地从书本上抬起头来。

chunks.head: wear off
chunks.gloss: 逐渐消退、慢慢减弱消失
chunks.note: 常用于痛感、新鲜感、药效、情绪等'渐渐淡去'。

literal.note_cn: 此处引申为'渐渐减弱',非'穿戴'义

chunks.ex_en: After an hour the pain began to wear off.
chunks.ex_cn: 一个小时后,疼痛开始渐渐消退。

chunks.head: clear up
chunks.note: clear up 指天气从阴雨转晴;也可指'澄清、解决'。本章为天气义。
chunks.ex_en: The sky finally cleared up after the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 雨后天空终于放晴了。

chunks.head: swallow up
chunks.note: 常指被海浪、黑暗、人群等'整个吞没'。
chunks.ex_en: The huge waves seemed ready to swallow up the little boat.
chunks.ex_cn: 巨浪仿佛要把那只小船整个吞没。

chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: 用于总结,'概括地说'。
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the whole trip was a great success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之,这趟旅行非常成功。

chunks.head: on foot
chunks.note: on foot = 靠双脚走(去某地)。

literal.note_cn: 此处'靠双脚',即步行

chunks.ex_en: We went to school on foot every day.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们每天步行上学。

chunks.head: to the bitter end
chunks.gloss: 坚持到底、直到最后关头
chunks.note: 源于航海:锚缆放到'bitter end'(系桩的最末端)。今用作'咬牙撑到最后'的固定说法。

literal.note_cn: 航海原指缆绳系'bitt(缆桩)'的一端,后与'苦'谐义

chunks.ex_en: No matter how hard it gets, we will fight to the bitter end.
chunks.ex_cn: 无论多难,我们都要坚持到底。

chunks.head: ride out the storm
chunks.note: ⚓航海说法:船'顶住风暴挺过去';也常喻'熬过困境'。

literal.note_cn: 此处指船'随浪起伏地挺过'

chunks.ex_en: The little ship managed to ride out the storm.
chunks.ex_cn: 那艘小船设法安然渡过了这场风暴。

chunks.head: bound for
chunks.note: ⚓航海/交通固定搭配:a ship bound for London = 一艘开往伦敦的船。此bound非'捆绑'。

literal.note_cn: 此处为形容词'驶往…的',非'捆'或'跳'

chunks.ex_en: They boarded a train bound for the coast.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们登上了一列开往海岸的火车。

chunks.head: on board
chunks.note: ⚓ go/come on board = 上船;be on board = 在船上。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'船上',非'木板'或'董事会'

chunks.ex_en: All the passengers were already on board.
chunks.ex_cn: 所有乘客都已经上船了。

chunks.head: at sea
chunks.note: ⚓ at sea 指'身处海上、在航行途中',区别于in the sea(在海水里)。

literal.note_cn: 固定搭配不加the

chunks.ex_en: The sailors spent three weeks at sea.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们在海上度过了三个星期。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: ⚓ on shore 与 at sea 相对,指'在陆地/岸上'。
chunks.ex_en: After the long voyage they were glad to be on shore.
chunks.ex_cn: 漫长航行后,他们很高兴能上岸。

chunks.head: come to an anchor
chunks.note: ⚓航海固定说法:船抛下锚停下来。同义 cast anchor。
chunks.ex_en: At dusk the ship came to an anchor near the island.
chunks.ex_cn: 黄昏时,船在岛边抛锚停泊。

chunks.head: all hands
chunks.note: ⚓航海固定说法:hands 指'船员'。all hands on deck = 全体船员上甲板。

literal.note_cn: 此处hand=水手/人手,非'手'

chunks.ex_en: The captain called all hands to the deck.
chunks.ex_cn: 船长把全体船员叫到甲板上。

chunks.head: before the wind
chunks.note: ⚓航海固定搭配:船朝风吹去的方向走,即'顺风行驶'。此before非'在…之前'。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'被风推着往前',非时间'之前'

chunks.ex_en: With sails full, the boat ran fast before the wind.
chunks.ex_cn: 帆张满时,小船顺风飞快地行驶。

chunks.head: spring a leak
chunks.note: ⚓航海固定搭配:船身裂开进水;也可喻'(计划、秘密)出现漏洞'。此spring非'春天/弹跳'。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'突然出现(裂口)',非'春天'

chunks.ex_en: Halfway across, the old boat sprang a leak.
chunks.ex_cn: 行到半途,那条旧船开始漏水了。

chunks.head: cast away
chunks.gloss: (船只)失事、遇难;(人)遭海难流落
chunks.note: ⚓航海用法:船被风浪毁掉、沉没;castaway(名词)即'海难流落者',正是本书主题。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'(被风浪)抛毁'

chunks.ex_en: The ship was cast away on a rocky coast.
chunks.ex_cn: 那艘船在礁石密布的海岸失事了。

chunks.head: go abroad
chunks.note: go abroad = 离开本国到外国(或出洋)。此处指鲁滨逊执意出海远行、离乡漂泊。
chunks.ex_en: She saved money for years so she could go abroad and study.
chunks.ex_cn: 她攒了好几年钱,好能出国留学。

chunks.head: break loose
chunks.gloss: 挣脱、摆脱束缚(私自出走)
chunks.note: break loose = 挣开束缚、脱身逃走;此处指他终于不顾父母反对私自出走。

literal.note_cn: 非'打碎'义(此处=挣脱)

chunks.ex_en: The dog broke loose from its chain and ran into the street.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只狗挣脱铁链,跑到了街上。

chunks.head: reflect upon
chunks.note: reflect upon (sth) = 对某事反复思考、反省。

literal.note_cn: 非'反射'义(此处=反思)

chunks.ex_en: Before you decide, take time to reflect upon what really matters.
chunks.ex_cn: 做决定前,花点时间好好想想什么才最要紧。

chunks.head: a great many
chunks.note: a great many + 可数名词复数 = 很多、大量;比 many 语气更强。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'伟大'(与 many 连用表'许多')

chunks.ex_en: A great many students signed up for the summer camp.
chunks.ex_cn: 许许多多学生报名参加了夏令营。

chunks.head: meet with
chunks.note: meet with (disasters/difficulties) = 遭遇、碰到(多指麻烦、灾祸)。

literal.note_cn: 非'会面'义(此处=遭遇、碰上)

chunks.ex_en: The travelers met with heavy rain on the mountain road.
chunks.ex_cn: 旅客们在山路上遇上了大雨。

chunks.head: look out for
chunks.note: look out for (sth) = 留意寻找、物色;此处指他又开始物色出海的机会。
chunks.ex_en: Look out for a cheap ticket when you plan your trip.
chunks.ex_cn: 计划出行时,留心找张便宜的票。

chunks.head: burst out
chunks.note: burst out (into passion/laughing/crying) = 情绪突然爆发。此处指对方突然发起脾气。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'胀破物体',指情绪突然迸出

chunks.ex_en: When she heard the news, she burst out crying.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到那消息,她突然大哭起来。

chunks.head: come to oneself
chunks.note: come to oneself (此处 come to myself) = 昏厥后苏醒、恢复知觉;正文为 came to myself。

literal.note_cn: come to = 苏醒过来(非'来到'义)

chunks.ex_en: He fainted for a moment, then came to himself and sat up.
chunks.ex_cn: 他昏过去一会儿,随后苏醒过来坐了起来。

chunks.head: to no purpose
chunks.note: to no purpose = 毫无用处、白搭。此处指去劝父亲也是白费口舌。

literal.note_cn: 此处 to no purpose=徒劳(非'目的'义)

chunks.ex_en: We argued for hours, but it was all to no purpose.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们争了好几个钟头,却全是白费。
